mentions.name: Bridgekeeper
mentions.description: This tool mitigates the cognitive debt of AI-assisted development by applying pedagogical research techniques to code review, helping developers better understand and recall AI-generated code; it converses in the voice of the Monty Python bridgekeeper.
mentions.problem: Even when reviewing AI-generated diffs line-by-line, developers don't understand the code as well as code they wrote themselves and have difficulty recalling it days later.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a tool for mitigating the cognitive debt from AI-assisted development. Even when I review Claude's diffs line-by-line, I don't understand them as well as code I wrote myself, and I have difficultly recalling them days later.

evidence.value: I'm working on a tool for mitigating the cognitive debt from AI-assisted development. Even when I review Claude's diffs line-by-line, I don't understand them as well as code I wrote myself, and I have difficultly recalling them days later.
